# Enhance Images

> 🤖 *AI Drafted (Not reviewed)*

Create contrast, sharpness, and light denoise image derivatives without modifying the originals. Useful for low-contrast scanned documents before OCR or transcription.

Tool: [Enhance Images](../tools/enhance_images.md) — Create contrast/sharpness/denoise image derivatives without modifying source files.
